projectile bounce: Increases the number of times a projectile will bounce off walls
pierce: Projectiles will now pierce through enemies
dodge: Increases chance to dodge incoming attacks
dodge chance: Increases chance to dodge incoming attacks
lifesteal chance: Increases chance to lifesteal on hit
critical chance: Increases chance to deal a critical on hit
projectiles: Increases number of projectiles on your weapon
bonus projectiles: Increases number of projectiles on your weapon
manasteal chance: Increases chance to manasteal on hit
dashes: Increases the number of dash charges you can hold
bonus dashes: Increases the number of dash charges you can hold
lifesteal power: The amount of HP you will steal when you lifesteal
manasteal power: The amount of HP you will steal when you manasteal
poison chance: The chance to apply poison status effect on hit
bonus projectile chance: The chance to shoot an extra projectile
size bonus: Increases or decreases the size of your collider
explosion size bonus: Increases or decreases the size of your collider
burn chance: The chance to apply burn status effect on hit
battle frenzy: Upon taking damage, gain Enraged status effect for 5 seconds
wraith form: Gives a percent chance to become Intangible when taking damage
dancing tempo: Upon dashing, gain Rapid Fire status effect for 2 seconds
demonic dance: Upon dashing, gain Vicious status effect for 2 seconds
arcane ripple: Upon casting an ability, summon an arcane missile (once per second)
explosive dash: Upon dashing, leave behind an explosion
mystic echo: Upon casting an ability, gain Focused status effect for 5 seconds
bind chance: The chance to apply bind status effect on hit
pierce chance: The chance for each projectile you shoot to pierce
chilling aura: Upon taking damage, apply slow to the enemy who damaged you
thorns: Upon taking damage, deal your Thorns as damage to the enemy who damaged you (nonlethal)
windwalker step: Upon succesfully dodging, gain haste for 5 seconds
frostweave nova: Upon taking damage, cause an explosion that clears nearby bullets slows monsters
luck: Gain additional chance for bosses to drop multiple items
bleed chance: The chance to apply bleed status effect on hit
burn reduction: Decrease the amount of damage you receive while burning
bleed reduction: Decrease the amount of damage you receive while bleeding
poison reduction: Decrease the amount of damage you receive while poisoned
explode on death: Upon dying, spawn an explosion of projectiles
damage %: Increases projectile damage by a percent
bonus damage percent: Increases projectile damage by a percent
assassinate: Upon backstabbing, make the enemy Fragile (once every 3 seconds)
opportunist: Upon backstabbing, gain Vicious status effect for 3 seconds
vanish: Upon killing an enemy, gain Shadowstep status effect for 3 seconds
endless dance: Upon killing an enemy, regain a dash
flowing strikes: Hits while you have Rapid Fire cut your dash recharge by 10% (once every 0.5 seconds)
riposte: Upon dodging, cut your dash recharge by 50%
spellweaver: Hits cut your ability cooldown by 2%
arcane flow: Critical hits cut your ability cooldown by 5%
soul siphon: Upon killing an enemy, gain 4 mana
deadeye: Upon a critical hit, make the enemy Fractured (once every 2 seconds)
executioner: Upon hitting an enemy below 30% health, gain Vicious status effect for 2 seconds
headhunter: Upon killing an enemy, gain Reflexive status effect for 4 seconds
volatile: Upon a critical hit, set off an explosion on the enemy (once per second)
chain reaction: Upon killing an enemy, set off a small explosion where it died
powder keg: Upon killing an enemy, cut your dash recharge by 25%
epidemic: Upon killing an enemy with Poison, Bleed or Burn, it bursts and poisons the enemies around it
festering: Upon hitting an enemy with Poison, Bleed or Burn, make it Weakened (once every 3 seconds)
phantom: Upon dodging, become Intangible for 1 second (once every 5 seconds)
slipstream: Upon dodging, gain Haste status effect for 2 seconds
measured strikes: Upon a critical hit, gain Enraged status effect for 3 seconds
undying: Upon a hit leaving you below 30% health, gain Invulnerable status effect for 2 seconds (once every 20 seconds)
second wind: Upon a hit leaving you below 50% health, gain Healing status effect for 3 seconds (once every 10 seconds)
rending fury: Hits while you are Enraged make the enemy Bleed (once per second)
bloodlust: Upon killing an enemy, gain 3 health
shatterpoint: Upon taking damage, clear the enemy shots near you (once every 4 seconds)
deflection: Upon dashing past an enemy shot, summon an arcane missile
shockwave: Upon a hit leaving you below 40% health, clear the enemy shots around you (once every 30 seconds)
blood magic: Abilities cost health instead of mana
transfusion: Upon casting an ability, gain Healing status effect for 3 seconds (once every 6 seconds)
necromancy: Upon killing an enemy, 2 spirits rise from it and hunt nearby enemies
grave chill: Upon killing an enemy, a chill bursts from it that slows the enemies around it
bone armor: Upon killing an enemy, gain Armored status effect for 4 seconds
blade wake: Upon dashing, send a slash along your dash that cuts through every enemy in its path
overflow: Gives a percent chance to summon an arcane missile on hit
minefield: Upon dashing, drop a mine that explodes when an enemy touches it
spite: Upon taking damage, drop a mine at your feet (once every 3 seconds)
caltrops: Upon dashing, scatter caltrops around you that hurt every enemy that steps on them
bonus invulnerability: Every point adds 10 ms to how long you are invulnerable after getting hit
earthshaker: Upon hitting an enemy, send a shockwave out around you (once every 2 seconds)
aftershock: Upon killing an enemy, send a small shockwave out around you
tremor: Upon hitting an enemy, make it Slow for 1 second (once every 2 seconds)
